lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are organized into vertical columns of 4 to 6 units, forming a regular grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits and extending along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the midsection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge runs across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with a high-luminance dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately eight remoras (Echeneidae) is localized around the ventral and posterior margins of the primary pectoral fin.
